name: standing lean back stomach stretch
description: A standing lean back that stretches the abdominal wall.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
